title: Closed immersions and (first order) thickenings restrict to opens of the ambient scheme
statement: Let $i:Z\to Z'$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion] with ideal sheaf $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_{Z'}$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Let $V'\subseteq Z'$ be an open subscheme with inclusion $j_{V'}:V'\to Z'$ [def-weil-open-immersion], let $V=i^{-1}(V')\subseteq Z$ be the corresponding open subscheme of $Z$ with inclusion $j_V$, and let $i_V:V\to V'$ be the unique morphism with $j_{V'}\circ i_V=i\circ j_V$ [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-factors-through-open-subscheme]. Then: (1) $i_V$ is a closed immersion; (2) its ideal sheaf $\mathcal I_V\subseteq\mathcal O_{V'}$ is the restriction of $\mathcal I$: $\mathcal I_V(W)=\mathcal I(W)$ inside $\mathcal O_{V'}(W)=\mathcal O_{Z'}(W)$ for every open (equivalently every affine open) $W\subseteq V'$; (3) if $\mathcal I^2=0$ then $\mathcal I_V^2=0$ [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers], and if $i$ is surjective on underlying spaces then so is $i_V$. Consequently, if $Z\subset Z'$ is a thickening, resp. a first order thickening [def-sbc-first-order-thickening], then so is $V\subset V'$; and if moreover $Z'$ is a scheme over a scheme $X$ via $h':Z'\to X$ and $U\subseteq X$ is an open subscheme with $h'(V')\subseteq U$, then $V\subset V'$ is a (first order) thickening over $U$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], $V'$ being over $U$ through the unique $h'_{V'}:V'\to U$ with $j_U\circ h'_{V'}=h'\circ j_{V'}$.
